target_customer: No paying customers stated; a research lab aiming at scientific discovery and later commercialization of ideas
problem: Current AI struggles to generalize from few examples. Ndea pursues guided program synthesis, with deep learning guiding the search for programs, toward AGI that can innovate.
business_model: Research lab; commercialization plan is to invent and commercialize ideas, no revenue model stated

founders.name: Francois Chollet
founders.background_notes: Creator of Keras and left Google in November 2024, per TechCrunch.

founders.name: Mike Knoop
founders.background_notes: Stayed on Zapier's board, per TechCrunch.

competitors.name: Safe Superintelligence
competitors.what: AGI lab founded by Ilya Sutskever

competitors.name: World Labs
competitors.what: Fei-Fei Li's lab building world models

technical_complexity.rationale: Merging deep learning with program synthesis for AGI is open research, and the company says its chance of success is low but not zero.

defensibility.rationale: Research talent and reputation of the founders are the assets; any result could be copied if published, and frontier labs are exploring program synthesis too.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Chollet says every frontier lab is starting to explore program synthesis. No acquisition known.

market_need_then: Chollet's ARC benchmark highlighted that scaled models lag at generalizing from few examples, and AGI investment was heavy in early 2025.

branding.name_origin: Company page says Ndea is like 'idea' with an n, inspired by the Greek ennoia (intuitive understanding) and dianoia (logical reasoning), reflecting the aim to merge deep learning with program synthesis.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious, visionary and candid about risk

branding.brand_signature: Name built from Greek concepts of intuition and reasoning
branding.community_and_virality: Launch covered by TechCrunch and other outlets in January 2025, driven largely by Chollet's reputation

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive meaningful name with strong press at launch, but the attention came from the founders' names more than the brand.

outcome_analysis: Ndea launched in January 2025 with Francois Chollet and Mike Knoop and joined YC in Winter 2026 with 15 people. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding is unclear, so the lab's runway and results are open questions in a field where large labs have far more capital.
notes: Aggregators (Seedtable, sig.ai) report about $43M seed with investors including Coatue, Factorial Capital and Quiet Capital, and sources disagree on timing (January 2025 versus the W26 batch). TechCrunch in January 2025 said Ndea had not disclosed outside funding. Seen only on aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Founders' education was not found on opened sources. Completeness pass: the $43M seed is recorded from Seedtable (dated 2025-01), a single database; TechCrunch in January 2025 said no outside funding was disclosed and other sources tie it to the W26 batch, so amount and date are uncertain.
